title: IMAX中国CEO：AI助力电影制作，降本增效带来更好故事
speaker: Daniel Munwaring

segments.en: Well, I think one interesting thing about China is, you know, the embracement of AI is tremendous here.
segments.zh: 中国对AI的拥抱程度令人惊叹。

segments.en: You know, we are, we're seeing it with iMacs, obviously, we've been using AI in a lot of our streaming technology and some of our end-to-end solutions in that area.
segments.zh: IMAX已在流媒体技术和端到端解决方案中广泛应用AI。

segments.en: Post-production is well well, but, you know, we're a filmmaker first company. So we think AI is going to be hugely beneficial for filmmakers.
segments.zh: 后期制作也是如此。我们本质是电影人公司，相信AI将极大惠及创作者。

segments.en: It's another tool for them to use, whether it's in the storyboarding process, you know, early on as they set up the script and set up scenes or more particularly in post-production.
segments.zh: AI是创作者的又一工具，无论是前期分镜、剧本场景搭建，还是后期制作。

segments.en: I think it's going to continue to bring down costs and be a productive tool for better storytelling.
segments.zh: AI将持续降低成本，成为讲好故事的得力工具。

segments.en: And as a result, you're going to see more capital blow into it and you're also going to see better movies. So we're extremely optimistic about it.
segments.zh: 因此会有更多资金涌入，也会诞生更好的电影。我们对此非常乐观。
